value.rationale: Shadow-area conditioned on combinatorial complexity is a natural joint stereological/geometric invariant not fixed by separately known normal-fan silhouette probabilities or total brightness moments. It gives a complete three-class first-moment classification of a canonical Platonic solid and an exact qualitative reversal between complexity and expected area, with a precise negative covariance. The claim is not a textbook parameter substitution and makes no downstream-theorem claim.
